findings.failure_consequence: a buggy/malicious worker sending retryable as a non-bool (e.g. string 'no') gets it journaled verbatim; downstream retry decisions may misread it. L3's own side strictly requires bool (read_report), so the two ends disagree on the wire type.
findings.fix: L2 validates isinstance(body['retryable'], bool) -> 400, mirroring read_report strictness
findings.smallest_targeted_test: POST /result with retryable='no' -> assert 400 (passes-200 today, journaled verbatim)
findings.title: POST /result accepts 'retryable' unvalidated (any JSON type journaled verbatim); artifacts entries likewise unchecked (fail-closed downstream via verifier rejection, so artifacts are by design)
